other_conditions: Construction worker must be registered with the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and have active membership
The worker must have completed at least one year (365 days) of membership after registration
Child must be enrolled in an educational institution recognized by a government‑established education board or university
Benefits are payable to a maximum of two children per registered construction worker
Bicycle subsidy is provided after the child passes class 9, 10, 11, or 12 and enrolls in the next class
benefits_summary: Provides lump‑sum scholarships ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹1,00,000 and a one‑time bicycle subsidy for children of registered construction workers.
